---
type: topic
title: Ollama
aliases: [ollama]
---
Local model runtime exposing an OpenAI-compatible API on port 11434. Supports
constrained decoding via the `format` parameter, which is how [[brain]] gets
reliable structured extraction out of small models instead of tool-calling.

Sibling runtimes with the same interface: LM Studio (1234), Jan (1337),
Msty (10000).
